items.period: Modern vector redraw of a Liushutong big-seal-style form; not a dated artifact
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 三 in Liushutong big-seal style.
items.alt: A modern vector drawing of 三 in Liushutong big-seal style.
items.selection_reason: Commons’ exact file description identifies the graph as 三, names the style, links the redraw to a Hanziyuan source record, and declares the SVG public domain. It can illustrate a later stylized form but is not evidence for an ancient artifact’s exact shape.
items.rights: Public domain per Commons file description; attribution appreciated but not required according to the page.

limitations.text: No verified oracle-bone or bronze artifact image was selected: the scholarly corpus source reports Shang numeral examples, but the accessible paleographic entry did not provide an independently inspectable original facsimile in this research pass.
